Featuring a restaurant, the hotel is located in proximity to Hang Duong. Ba Dinh Historic Square is only 1.4 km from this 4-star hotel, while the Temple of the Jade Mountain is about 900 metres away. As a plus for business travellers, the turtle Thap Rua Tower is 11 minutes' walk away. Guests might as well visit Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, which is 1.3 km away. There is the Union Park 25 minutes' stroll away, while Good Morning Cat Ba bus station is just steps from the Boutique Hotel & Spa. This accommodation is near Ha Noi train station, about 2 km away. The rooms include an air conditioner, along with such modern comforts as a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Also, there is a personal safe, a minibar fridge provided. Guests will make use of hairdryers and shower caps in bathrooms equipped with a bidet and a separate toilet. The rooms at Hanoi Boutique Hotel & Spa offer views of the city. A kid-friendly buffet breakfast is offered at this hotel.
